notes: Prebuilt decks now use four unclipped hero-style leader panels. Home music is faster and includes prominent crashing-wave and thunder accents.
fixes: Added new Recovery Skill amulets for Courage (Face It Head-On) and Hope (Second Chances), and fixed Serenity's Sanctuary of Serenity so it works in real matches, not just the tutorial.
Fixed prebuilt decks that were randomly 40 or 41 cards depending on class.
Fixed several Dev/showcase decks that were silently missing cards due to name typos.
Redesigned the Evolution panel so tiers are easier to read at a glance.
upcoming_events: More seasonal content and cards are in development — check back after future updates for details.
